body:
# Preserve specific peptone identities and both ingredients in MediaDive recipes

Six MediaDive solutions (2722, 3504, 4640, 4792, 5071, 5286) lost one ingredient edge because equal quantities of Tryptone and Casamino acids both resolved to FOODON:03315719. Solution 1579 also collapsed Trypticase and Tryptone. Stale broad milk-protein synonyms outranked reviewed specific MIM identities.

Preserve Tryptone/Bacto-tryptone as MICRO:0000182, Trypticase as MICRO:0000175, and Casamino acids as FOODON:03315719. Use scoped identity exclusions, not deletion of legitimate authority entities. Identity rejection must not remove asymmetric broadMatch/narrowMatch parent assertions in runtime lookup, full export, or bounded refresh.

Acceptance:
- Immutable identity and parent-relation regressions.
- Bounded vendored SSSOM refresh preserves all 610,059 rows and 143 asymmetric parent assertions, removing only 22 conflicting lexical synonyms.
- Distinct ingredient identities and all 14 raw quantities survive in seven rebuilt recipes.
- No solution loses ingredient coverage across 4,838 MediaDive solutions.
- The original 96/358 wrong media paths are absent while all affected media and legitimate authority entities remain.

The local corrected archive SHA256 2fdbc4d248baefee1be226c3adaacc1723b24c9308cef609221d4079c7eb47fd passed saved project acceptance (not strict Biolink conformance). Evidence: data/rebuild-verified-20260921.2fdbc4d2/. This issue tracks shipping and independent review of the local correction; publication of an official release is not included.
title: Preserve specific peptone identities and distinct MediaDive recipe ingredients
